questions.question: Through Zechariah, God spoke to people who had fasted and mourned for seventy years. What did He ask them about it?

answers.text: Whether it was really for Him

questions.question: Through Zechariah, God told His people what not to do to the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner and the poor?
When God told His people through Zechariah to show true justice and compassion, they paid close attention. True or false?
In Zechariah's message, God scattered His people with a whirlwind. Where did they end up?

answers.text: Among nations they had not known
Out in the wilderness of Sinai
